import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,base64,sys
from pathlib import Path
r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f','14','-l','14','-scale-to','1800','-singlefile','-jpeg','inputs/sources/wavelet.pdf'],capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
b=base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode()
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),'visual/wavelet-14.jpg','--base64'],input=b,text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
print(b)
